mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.title AS title, p.content AS content, m.name AS name, TO_CHAR(p.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdAt FROM tb_post p JOIN tb_member m ON p.member_id = m.member_id WHERE p.case_type IN ('NOTICE', '공지', '공지사항') ORDER BY p.post_id DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CASE WHERE TRUNC(CREATED_AT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CONSULT WHERE TRUNC(CREATED_AT) BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 6 AND TRUNC(SYSDATE)

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.title AS title, m.name AS name, TO_CHAR(p.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdAt FROM tb_post p JOIN tb_member m ON p.member_id = m.member_id ORDER BY p.post_id DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(c.CREATED_AT), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "date", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM TB_CASE c WHERE TRUNC(c.CREATED_AT) BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) - #{offsetDays} AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) GROUP BY TRUNC(c.CREATED_AT) ORDER BY TRUNC(c.CREATED_AT) ASC

SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.title AS title, p.content AS content, m.name AS name, TO_CHAR(p.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdAt FROM tb_post p JOIN tb_member m ON p.member_id = m.member_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId}
